moves.head: Cardinals extend TE Elijah Higgins for three years, up to $26.8M
moves.plain: Arizona added three years to Higgins' rookie deal, which ran out after this season. The extension can pay up to $26.8M and keeps him signed through 2029. Guarantees were not reported.

moves.head: Eagles waive backup T Fred Johnson
moves.plain: Johnson re-signed in March on a one-year deal and had played 24 snaps. He goes on waivers; if no team claims him, Philadelphia carries nearly $2M in dead money.

moves.head: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson has surgery on a broken, dislocated thumb
moves.plain: Jackson was already on injured reserve. Coach Jesse Minter says injuries like this usually take six to 10 weeks, so he is aiming for a late-season return.

moves.head: Kirk Cousins to start for the Vikings at Green Bay with Kyler Murray hurt
moves.plain: Three days after Minnesota traded to bring him back, Cousins starts Sunday because Murray has a hamstring injury.

moves.head: Falcons give CB C.J. Henderson a two-year extension worth up to $20M
moves.plain: Atlanta announced a two-year extension for Henderson, who was headed for free agency after this season. The deal is worth up to $20M with almost $11M guaranteed. It keeps him signed through 2028 (calculated: the report gives no end year).

moves.head: Falcons extend edge rusher Cameron Thomas for three years, up to $33M
moves.plain: Thomas signed a one-year deal worth just over $3M in March and earned a raise. The three-year extension has a maximum value of $33M and runs through 2029. Guarantees were not reported.

moves.head: Rams change course and put WR Puka Nacua on injured reserve
moves.plain: A day after saying he would stay on the roster, the Rams put Nacua (knee sprains and turf toe) on injured reserve. He misses at least four games. Brennan Presley takes his roster spot.

moves.head: Thursday night: Commanders beat Giants 24-21
moves.plain: Jayden Daniels hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard touchdown with 57 seconds left. Washington moves to 3-5-1 and the Giants fall to 5-3-1. Washington now holds the tiebreaker after the teams tied in October.

moves.head: Eagles waive WR Marquise Brown
moves.plain: Both sides agreed a split would help. He signed a one-year deal with $5M guaranteed in March, so that money is already owed. As a vested veteran he goes through waivers first.

moves.head: Cardinals name rookie QB Carson Beck their starter
moves.plain: With Minshew out after an elbow injury, the third-round pick gets his first NFL start, against the Rams.

moves.head: Browns start Deshaun Watson against the Texans
moves.plain: Cleveland picked Watson over Shedeur Sanders to start Sunday's game in Houston.

moves.head: Broncos call off their deadline-day trade for Chargers LB Daiyan Henley
moves.plain: Denver says the deal will not be finalized, so Henley stays with the Chargers and no picks change hands. The team gave no reason. Henley is in the last year of his rookie deal and can become a free agent in March.

moves.head: Rams will not place WR Puka Nacua on injured reserve despite knee sprains and turf toe
moves.plain: Nacua has sprained MCL and PCL ligaments in his right knee plus turf toe. Sean McVay says he will miss an extended stretch, but the Rams are keeping him on the active roster rather than using injured reserve.

moves.head: Longtime Steelers running back and assistant coach Dick Hoak dies at 86
moves.plain: Hoak spent his whole career in Pittsburgh, first as a running back and then for decades as the running backs coach. He coached on four Super Bowl winners.

moves.head: Raiders name rookie Fernando Mendoza their starting QB
moves.plain: With Kirk Cousins traded back to Minnesota, the No. 1 overall pick takes over. His first start is Sunday against Seattle.

moves.head: Vikings reacquire QB Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick
moves.plain: Cousins goes back to Minnesota, where he played from 2018 to 2023. The Raiders get a third-round pick and no longer owe him a fully guaranteed $10M roster bonus due in March 2027. Las Vegas pays him only about $500K of his 2026 salary; the Vikings cover the rest. Las Vegas named rookie Fernando Mendoza its starter after the trade.

moves.head: Chiefs acquire WR Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks
moves.plain: Kansas City adds a slot receiver for the second half of the season. Downs is in the last year of his rookie deal, so he can be a free agent after the season. Indianapolis, at 2-7, picks up two mid-round picks.

moves.head: Bills acquire S Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth-round pick from the Titans for a 2027 second-round pick
moves.plain: Buffalo adds a starting safety under contract through 2028. Tennessee keeps none of the roughly $4.5M left on his 2026 pay. The Bills restructured LT Dion Dawkins' deal to make the cap room; the figures were not reported.

moves.head: 49ers acquire WR Keenan Allen from the Colts for a 2027 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: San Francisco adds a veteran receiver with Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel hurt. Allen signed a one-year deal with Indianapolis in August, so he is a free agent again after the season.

moves.head: Ravens get C Ryan Neuzil from the Falcons for G Andrew Vorhees and a 2028 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Baltimore has put three centers on injured reserve this season, and Neuzil has started all 38 of his career games at center. Atlanta gets a backup guard and a late pick. Neuzil is a pending free agent.

moves.head: Dolphins put DT Zach Sieler (biceps, season-ending surgery) and QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve
moves.plain: Sieler needs surgery on a ruptured biceps and is out for the season. Willis will miss at least four games, so Kyle McCord starts at quarterback in Week 10.

moves.head: Cardinals put QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) and WR Michael Wilson (neck) on injured reserve
moves.plain: Minshew's elbow injury will likely need season-ending surgery, and Wilson is out for the season. Carson Beck is in line to start at quarterback, and Arizona signed QBs Josh Johnson and Joey Aguilar for depth.

moves.head: Ravens, Patriots and Panthers restructure Nnamdi Madubuike, Hunter Henry and Taylor Moton for cap room
moves.plain: Baltimore turned most of Madubuike's 2026 salary into a bonus and added two void years, clearing $8.66M. New England's base-to-bonus conversion for Henry cleared $3.3M. Carolina converted $5.3M of Moton's salary, saving $3.5M now and pushing more of his cap charge into later years.

moves.head: 49ers rookie DT Gracen Halton out for the season with a broken ankle
moves.plain: The fourth-round pick had started 7 of 9 games. San Francisco placed him on injured reserve.

moves.head: Bills restructure LT Dion Dawkins' contract to fit the Amani Hooker trade
moves.plain: GM Brandon Beane said Buffalo reworked Dawkins' deal to make cap room for Hooker. No figures were reported, so his contract numbers here are unchanged.

moves.head: Eagles-Bengals trade for LB Arnold Ebiketie called off
moves.plain: The deal for a 2027 sixth-round pick was agreed, then dropped the same night: it would have cost Cincinnati the 2027 third-round compensatory pick it is due. Ebiketie stays in Philadelphia.

moves.head: Falcons release K Nick Folk and sign K Jake Moody off the Ravens' practice squad
moves.plain: Folk had made 13 of 18 field goals this season. Moody gets another chance as Atlanta's kicker.

moves.head: Saints C Erik McCoy to miss time with a biceps injury
moves.plain: Kellen Moore expects McCoy back this season. Cesar Ruiz moves from guard to center while he is out.

moves.head: Jaguars acquire DT Jordan Davis from the Eagles for a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick
moves.plain: Jacksonville takes on Davis' three-year, $78M extension signed in March, which runs through 2029. Philadelphia, at 2-7, adds a second 2027 first-round pick. It was the Jaguars' third trade of the day.

moves.head: Jaguars acquire DT Davon Godchaux from the Saints for a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Godchaux steps in at nose tackle after DaVon Hamilton's season-ending quad injury. He is in the last year of his contract. Per ESPN, the pick becomes a 2027 sixth-rounder if Jacksonville acquires one.

moves.head: Lions acquire S Andre Cisco from the Jets for a sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Detroit adds safety depth while Kerby Joseph works back from a knee injury. Cisco, 26, had barely played on defense since Week 3 and is on a one-year deal. NFL.com and ESPN list the Jets' pick as a 2028 sixth-rounder, Pro Football Rumors as 2029, so the year is left off here. The Jets carry $500K in dead money and save $1.75M, per Pro Football Rumors.

picks: Sixth-round pick, year reported differently (from DET)

moves.head: Jaguars acquire S Jessie Bates from the Falcons for a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick
moves.plain: Jacksonville gets the All-Pro safety and Atlanta gets two future picks. Atlanta is keeping most of his remaining 2026 salary to make the deal work, per NFL Network. His contract voids shortly after this season, so he is set to be a free agent.

moves.head: Bills place WR Josh Palmer on injured reserve with a hamstring injury
moves.plain: Palmer will miss at least four games. He is in the second year of the three-year deal he signed in 2025.

moves.head: NFL reinstates WR Brandon Aiyuk to the 49ers; release reported as likely
moves.plain: Aiyuk comes off the reserve/left squad list and passed his physical. San Francisco has until Nov. 23 to make a roster move, and a release was reported as likely. No release had been confirmed when this was written.

moves.head: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes day-to-day with an elbow injury
moves.plain: He hurt his throwing elbow in the 35-12 win over the Jets. An MRI showed no major damage, and he looks on track to start at Atlanta.

moves.head: Packers RB Josh Jacobs to have finger surgery and miss time
moves.plain: Jacobs broke a finger and is expected to miss no more than about three games. Green Bay has its bye in Week 11.

moves.head: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold out for Week 10 with a quad injury; Drew Lock to start
moves.plain: Seattle hopes Darnold is back after its Week 11 bye. Lock, who started the Week 9 win over Arizona, starts again against Las Vegas despite an oblique injury.

moves.head: 49ers place WR Christian Kirk on injured reserve with a knee injury
moves.plain: Kirk has a meniscus injury in his knee and must miss at least four games. San Francisco activated WR Demarcus Robinson to fill the spot.

moves.head: Rams activate DE Myles Garrett from injured reserve
moves.plain: Garrett was hurt in Week 1 and had arthroscopic knee surgery. He is set to return after missing everything since his Rams debut.

moves.head: Rams place CB Jaylen Watson on injured reserve for shoulder surgery
moves.plain: Watson will have season-ending shoulder surgery, so the Rams put him on IR to open a roster spot for Garrett.

moves.head: Seahawks LG Quenton Nelson to have knee surgery, miss multiple games
moves.plain: Nelson, acquired from the Colts last month, needs knee cartilage surgery and is expected to miss a few weeks. He was not placed on injured reserve.

moves.head: Ravens place QBs Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on injured reserve
moves.plain: Both Baltimore quarterbacks are on IR. Huntley's turf toe ends his season. The Ravens activated rookie QB Austin Reed and have undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano as the Week 9 starter, so they went looking for help at the position.

moves.head: Ravens agree to acquire QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals
moves.plain: Baltimore gets the 33-year-old backup quarterback and a 2027 fifth-round pick; Arizona gets a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 seventh-round pick, per NFL.com. Arizona reworked his 2026 deal to make it easier for Baltimore to take on, turning $2.7M of remaining salary into a signing bonus. He is a pending free agent and is expected to start for the Ravens.

moves.head: CB Arthur Maulet retires at 33
moves.plain: Maulet played nine NFL seasons for six teams. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley out for the season with turf toe
moves.plain: Huntley will have surgery and is expected to go on injured reserve. With Lamar Jackson also out, Joe Fagnano is set to make his first career start in Week 9 and Baltimore could look for a veteran QB before the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

moves.head: Browns QB Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol
moves.plain: Watson took a helmet-to-helmet hit in Week 8. He must clear the protocol by Saturday to play Week 9; otherwise Shedeur Sanders starts.

moves.head: Commanders put DT Daron Payne, DL Javon Kinlaw and RB Jeremy McNichols on IR
moves.plain: All three are done for the year: Payne with a fractured foot, Kinlaw after MCL surgery. Washington also claimed RB Robert Henry Jr. off waivers from Seattle.

moves.head: Giants extend CB Greg Newsome for three years, $46M
moves.plain: Newsome gets $46M over three more years, about $15.3M a year, with $32M guaranteed. He had been on a one-year, $8M deal, so he will not reach free agency in 2027.

moves.head: Colts agree to two-year, $35M extension with DT Adetomiwa Adebawore
moves.plain: The deal is worth $35M with a $13M signing bonus, and $22.5M of it is new money due by the end of 2027. The report gives the average as $17M a year; guaranteed money was not stated.

moves.head: Bills release S C.J. Gardner-Johnson
moves.plain: Cutting him frees $500K in cap space and leaves $2.02M in dead money. He was on a one-year, $3.5M deal with $3.02M guaranteed.

moves.head: Saints release K Daniel Carlson, claim RB Audric Estime from Browns
moves.plain: Releasing Carlson saves $1.26M in cap room; his 2026 deal was $1.49M with none guaranteed. New Orleans also claimed running back Audric Estime off waivers from Cleveland.

moves.head: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. finishes eight-game suspension
moves.plain: Pearce is eligible to be activated after serving his suspension under the personal conduct policy. The Falcons also waived EDGE Jared Ivey and Drake Jackson.

moves.head: Panthers hire DeAngelo Hall as cornerbacks coach
moves.plain: The former Pro Bowl cornerback returns to Carolina's staff after the team fired defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero. Todd Wash is the interim coordinator.

moves.head: Week 8 early games: Bills rout Ravens 36-10, Bengals top Titans 43-36 in OT
moves.plain: Cardinals beat Cowboys 33-30 in overtime and Lions edged Vikings 19-15. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and Joe Burrow threw five touchdowns.

moves.head: Week 8: Jaguars 42-7 over Colts, Raiders 38-33 over Jets, Steelers 27-6 over Browns
moves.plain: Buccaneers shut out the Falcons 16-0 in the rain, with Bucky Irving running for 170 yards. The Jets fell to 2-6.

moves.head: Week 8 late games: Broncos top Chiefs 28-24, Commanders beat Eagles 27-10
moves.plain: Rams beat Chargers 24-9 (Chargers 0-7), Patriots beat Dolphins 24-19. Philadelphia has lost six straight.

moves.head: Lions LB Jack Campbell hospitalized with a neck injury
moves.plain: Campbell was carted off in the fourth quarter against the Vikings and stayed in a local hospital overnight for monitoring. The Lions will give more updates.

moves.head: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson to have thumb surgery, goes on injured reserve
moves.plain: Jackson hurt his thumb on the first snap of the Week 8 loss in Buffalo. He will miss at least four games and it is unclear if he returns this season. Baltimore is down to rookie Joe Fagnano as its only healthy QB.

moves.head: Eagles will not trade RB Saquon Barkley before the deadline
moves.plain: ESPN reports Philadelphia is keeping Barkley, who is under contract through 2028. The trade deadline is Nov 10.

moves.head: Steelers and Chiefs linked to Jaguars WR Brian Thomas Jr.
moves.plain: Jacksonville is reportedly open to moving Thomas but may wait until closer to the Nov 10 deadline.

moves.head: Raiders want Kirk Cousins to keep starting as long as possible
moves.plain: Per ESPN, Las Vegas is not ruling out a QB change but does not blame Cousins for the slump. Rookie Fernando Mendoza would be next. Las Vegas named rookie Fernando Mendoza its starter after the trade.

moves.head: Colts open to trading RB Jonathan Taylor
moves.plain: Indianapolis is not actively shopping him but would listen. The Giants and Vikings are seen as the front-runners.

moves.head: NFL reviewing new abuse allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
moves.plain: The league says it will review the new allegations as part of its open investigation.

moves.head: Chargers place S Derwin James on injured reserve
moves.plain: James has a hamstring injury and can return no earlier than Week 12.

moves.head: Broncos place RB RJ Harvey on injured reserve
moves.plain: Harvey has a knee injury. Denver added S Taylor Rapp from the practice squad.

moves.head: Jets place DT T'Vondre Sweat on injured reserve
moves.plain: Sweat has a knee injury and will miss at least four games. New York signed DT Payton Page from the practice squad.

moves.head: Chiefs CB L'Jarius Sneed headed back to injured reserve
moves.plain: Sneed has a knee issue. CB Melvin Smith takes his roster spot.

moves.head: Bears get DT Jeffery Simmons from the Titans for two first-round picks
moves.plain: Tennessee gets Chicago's 2027 and 2028 first-round picks and a 2027 fourth. Chicago also gets a 2028 fifth. Simmons, 29, is a first-team All-Pro who signed a three-year, $105.8M extension in June. He has 4 sacks and 12 pressures in 7 games for the 1-6 Titans, and the 5-2 Bears had been looking for help rushing the passer.

moves.head: Titans claim DT Jonah Laulu off waivers
moves.plain: The Raiders cut Laulu on Oct 27 and Tennessee won the waiver claim, then waived DT Timmy Horne. Several other teams also put in claims. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Seahawks cut G Christian Haynes; Dolphins claim him
moves.plain: Seattle released the guard on Oct 27 and Miami picked him up off waivers the next day, cutting DJ Campbell. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Colts trade DT DeForest Buckner back to the 49ers
moves.plain: Indianapolis sends the 32-year-old defensive tackle to San Francisco, where he started his career, for a 2027 fourth-round pick. He had four sacks in seven games for the 2-5 Colts. The 49ers have lost several defensive linemen to injury, and no new contract was reported.

moves.head: Colts agree to trade G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks
moves.plain: Seattle sends Indianapolis a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick for the veteran guard. He is in the last year of his contract, and no new deal was reported.

moves.head: Browns extend DT Maliek Collins for two years
moves.plain: Cleveland agreed to a two-year, $30 million extension with the defensive tackle, with $23 million guaranteed. It keeps him under contract through 2028.

moves.head: 49ers release DL Ogbonnia Okoronkwo
moves.plain: San Francisco released the defensive lineman on Oct. 23. No other detail was reported.

moves.head: Vikings release RB DeeJay Dallas and T Tristan Leigh
moves.plain: Minnesota cut both players and added OLB Jihad Ward to the practice squad. No contract terms were reported.

moves.head: Steelers release S Rayshawn Jenkins
moves.plain: Pittsburgh cut the 32-year-old safety, who had mostly become a special-teams player. The move likely clears a roster spot for starter DeShon Elliott to return from injured reserve. Jenkins was on a one-year deal worth about $1.3 million.

moves.head: Rams sign veteran K Brandon McManus after Blake Grupe's ACL tear
moves.plain: The Rams lost kicker Blake Grupe to a torn ACL, so they worked out Brandon McManus and Matt Prater and chose McManus. It is their third kicker in about two weeks. His deal is expected to be a veteran-minimum contract.

moves.head: Winless Dolphins cut K Riley Patterson and CB Storm Duck and bring back Zane Gonzalez
moves.plain: Miami is 0-5 and releasing kicker Riley Patterson after early misses. Zane Gonzalez returns on a practice-squad deal to kick, and Justin Tucker also worked out for the team. Patterson was on a one-year, $1.4M deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs little. Cornerback Storm Duck, who started the year on PUP, goes to waivers.

moves.head: Falcons poach edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice
moves.plain: Atlanta signed edge rusher Charles Snowden to its active roster from Washington's practice squad. To make room, it is waiving Bralen Trice, who could return to the practice squad if he clears waivers.

moves.head: Tuesday roster churn: Eagles waive two RBs, 49ers cut Naquan Jones, Cowboys waive Caelen Carson
moves.plain: The Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Carson Steele (Steele with an injury designation). The 49ers released DT Naquan Jones, and the Cowboys waived CB Caelen Carson to promote S Juanyeh Thomas from the practice squad. Along with Davante Adams, the Rams also put DT Poona Ford on IR.

moves.head: Titans release DT Jordan Elliott after an off-field incident
moves.plain: The release follows an incident on Oct 15. His two-year, $8M deal had $3.24M guaranteed at signing. Guaranteed money is owed even after a cut, so expect some of it to show up as dead money.

moves.head: Giants cut RB Najee Harris as teams reshuffle their rosters
moves.plain: Harris was on a veteran-minimum deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs the Giants almost nothing. The Falcons added edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice. The Dolphins swapped kickers and waived CB Storm Duck.

moves.head: Texans get WR Marvin Harrison Jr. from the Cardinals
moves.plain: Arizona gets Houston's 2027 second-round and sixth-round picks and also sends a 2027 seventh to Houston, per the Cardinals' announcement. Harrison now counts on Houston's cap.

moves.head: More October moves: Falcons extend Gervon Dexter, Eagles cut Andy Dalton
moves.plain: Atlanta extended DL Gervon Dexter. Philadelphia released QB Andy Dalton, and right tackle Lane Johnson is retiring. New England put WR Romeo Doubs on injured reserve, and Pittsburgh added WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling to its practice squad. The terms were not in the report.

moves.head: Ravens get center Cam Jurgens from the Eagles
moves.plain: Philadelphia gets a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second and also sends a 2027 seventh to Baltimore. The Eagles still carry about $4.6M of his old bonus as dead money.

moves.head: Cowboys get CB Joey Porter Jr. from the Steelers
moves.plain: Contract talks stalled. Porter reportedly wanted about $30M a year and Pittsburgh would not go past the high $20Ms in new money. The Steelers get a 2027 sixth and a 2028 second.

moves.head: Giants get QB J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings
moves.plain: Minnesota gets a 2027 fifth-round pick. McCarthy is still on his rookie deal; the Vikings keep about $5.1M of dead money from it.
